title: Message from Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc - — May 25

public_detail: Please do not reply to this message. Resource Property Management offices are closed today in observance of the Memorial Day holiday. If you have an emergency on the common areas of your community, please contact any of our offices by calling 727-581-2662; 727-864-0004; 727-796-5900 or 941-348-2912 and following the prompts to be connected to our After Hours Emergency Services Department. After providing detailed information on the common area emergency the on-call manager will return your call promptly to assist you with the reported emergency issue. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
